test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Read the sentence carefully and select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined part.

Greta Thunberg’s __tirade __against environmental degeneration shocked the world leaders.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term "**tirade**" typically refers to a long and angry speech, especially one that criticizes someone or something.
 
• In the context of Greta Thunberg's speech, **"long and angry speech"** accurately captures the essence of her message against environmental degeneration.
 
• The other options do not fit the context as precisely as **"long and angry speech" **does.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"Greta Thunberg’s* long and angry speech *against environmental degeneration shocked the world leaders."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "debatable account"** – This does not convey the intensity and length of Greta Thunberg's speech.
 
• **Option 2: "minute observation"** – This implies a detailed, careful look at something, which is not the case here.
 
• **Option 4: "innate liberal opinion"** – This does not capture the nature of the speech.
